text: Stagflation risk is building — September payrolls came in at just 29,000 jobs while CPI jumped to 3.7%, meaning the economy is slowing sharply while inflation is accelerating, and the Fed has signaled it may hike rather than cut, which is a tough environment for risk assets.
Sell QBTS — it's down 58% with no earnings, 21% short interest, and insiders are selling, which means the smart money is betting against this stock and you should get out before it falls further.
Sell IONQ — down 35% with negative earnings, negative cash flow, and 10% short interest, quantum computing is still years from generating real revenue and this stock is burning cash while it waits.
Sell RGTI — down 58% with shrinking revenue of -34%, 20% short interest, insiders selling, and 74% below its high, this is a broken stock with a deteriorating business underneath it.

Trim NCLP.L — you're down 34% with the weakest momentum of all your ETFs and every technical signal pointing lower, so reduce your exposure now rather than hoping for a turnaround in a weakening economy.
Raise your MSTR stop from $125.43 to $131.71 to lock in more protection on this volatile Bitcoin-linked position that's still 53% off its high with insiders selling.

Add to GOOGL — at a PE of 22 with 15% revenue growth and insiders buying, Google is genuinely cheap for its quality and is one of the few large-cap names with both value and growth working in its favor.

Add to MU — a PE of just 4.3 with 49% revenue growth and consistent earnings beats makes Micron look like a deep value opportunity, though size the position carefully given the stagflationary macro backdrop.
